★ Request
Display Curren Bouquetd'or (Winter Gym Uniform)

――Ah, ...yes.
Even though I know it's not sincere... ――

I see! Knowing what was holding me back takes such a load off my mind!
Bouquet-san, could I ask you to run with me again sometime?!
Eh?! Me――?

Fufu, indeed. ――To be able to help with my running――
and create "harmony"... made me very happy.

Six interval runs done!
Um... I know it's a bit late to ask, but do you think I'll make it in time for the real race?

Yes... I will think it over.
Until these doubts―― fade away completely.

Haha, that's what I like about you. That's why I know I can leave it in your capable hands.
I'm counting on you!

――――
...I should. ――Head back to training, too.

Bouquet-chan! What's wrong?
If you keep looking away while running, you're going to hurt yourself.

Yes, absolutely! My Trainer
said it was fine, but... I just couldn't stop worrying about it.

(Coaching as a substitute――
I suppose trainers help each other out like that sometimes.)

The pleasure is mine. Thank you very much for inviting me.
For the first time in a while―― I felt the joy of running.

(She looks―― relieved. Even though she seemed so anxious just a moment ago.
Is that thanks to the Trainer's guidance――?)

Toward everyone whose hearts burn with such passion to win...
my own running―― could hardly be called sincere...
――We're almost at the fourth corner. Spurt now!

Ah... ――I'm sorry.
You're right... I think―― I'll go take a break.
Thanks! Sorry about this, especially when you've got scouting prep to do.

Even knowing it, I can't change―― and in the end, I ruin it.
Everyone's harmony. ――Their brilliance.

I mean... stamina isn't something you build overnight.
Even if I start working on it now...

...――
I started racing because I was captivated by the beauty of "harmony."

The Fukushima Kinen is a 2000m graded race.
She's lost multiple times at 2000, so I want to address it early――

Are you free for a while? Would you mind looking after
one of the Umamusume on my team until the Fukushima Kinen?

I have to focus on coaching the girls running in the Tokyo race on the same day.
It'll be tough for me to accompany her on the away trip.

(The discipline-specific competition... What should I do?
Running while still torn about whether I should quit racing――)

(Wow, what a transformation―― Having someone stand by you when you're anxious like that...
really helps you look forward, doesn't it? Fufufu.)

The Mile for me, of course! It's a huge biannual chance
to run against debuted seniors! I wanna take on Taiki-senpai!

Yes, with pleasure.
I would―― truly love to run together again.
Trainer... ――

*pant*, *pant*... My final lap times are completely hopeless...
If I'm going to run 2000m, I need to increase my stamina training.
――...Really...?

You mentioned it was to review your pacing, right?
Are you better at longer distances, Bouquet-san?
! I see, right here! Hyaaaaaaaah!!

(――Trainer has always stood by me...
Why do your words feel... so very warm...?)

...To run with feelings like this――
Wouldn't that be disrespectful to everyone...?

! Yes...! If there's still anything we can do!
Every last bit of it!
(The scenery passing by. The wind caressing my cheek―― it felt wonderful.)

Have you decided which event you'll enter for the upcoming competition?
...I'm still torn between the 1600m and the 1800m...

............Phew. I caused trouble for everyone.
I need to focus properly――

I'll do my absolute best as your pacing partner.
So―― how should I run?
Ah―― Trainer. Thank you for your hard work.

However, I'm not good at conflict.
Even in races, I can't push myself forward―― and just end up disrupting the harmony.

――I'm sure I ought to quit racing.
And yet―― ...and yet――
――――Phew.

(――She prefers waiting in the back.
That makes it―― much easier to run.)

Yay, I was able to push hard all the way to the end!
Though the time didn't change much, did it?
